title: 5d-review-2: review core (resolver, waivers)
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to review

Core checkpoint: 5d-4 (boundary resolver), 5d-5 (constraint waivers).

### Focus areas

- **Boundary resolver (5d-4)**: correctness of component_membership join, cache generation-counter logic, behavior when component membership is empty or stale, mixed boundary + forbidden_dep constraints handled correctly
- **Constraint waivers (5d-5)**: durable table survives reindex, CRUD methods follow existing DB patterns, orphan detection works, waiver scoping (file vs symbol) is clear

### Stable state after this checkpoint

All data paths exist. Boundary constraints resolve to file-level pairs and feed DD. Waivers are stored durably. Ready for integration layer.
